name: lex-integrity
description: Local AI Policy & Regulatory Compliance Matrix

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm start"
scripts.dev:ai: concurrently -n server,client,ollama,ngrok -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm start" "set OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434&& set OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*&& ollama serve" "ngrok http 11434"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.test: cd server && npm run test && cd client && npm test
scripts.lint: cd server && npx eslint src && cd client && npx eslint src
